walmart_postgres_sandbox.description: Read/write access limited to the sandboxed Postgres FORK, never production.

walmart_databricks.description: Ad-hoc SQL against Unity Catalog (Walmart.bronze / silver_t / silver_b / gold).

notes: Connect this file in VS Code's MCP settings (or Claude Desktop) to enable natural-language ad-hoc querying.
The postgres server MUST point at PG_FORK_DB, never PG_DB, to guarantee production tables can't be mutated from chat.
Run `python ingestion/db_fork.py create` to refresh the sandbox fork before an exploration session.
